title: Stylish 4BR - Rooftop Deck Near Downtown
description:
✔️ East Nashville location — minutes to Broadway and Five Points
✔️ Rooftop deck with skyline views, fire pit, and outdoor TV
✔️ 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms — sleeps up to 12
✔️ Designer interiors with open-concept living
✔️ Full kitchen with breakfast bar
✔️ Pet-friendly with garage parking

The space
• Modern East Nashville home designed for families and group getaways
• Open-concept living room with smart TV and fully equipped kitchen for gathering
• Private rooftop deck with grill, fire pit, outdoor dining, and skyline views
• Four private ensuite bedrooms plus a queen sleeper sofa for flexible sleeping
• Perfect for families, friend groups, and Nashville adventures

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Open-concept living room with designer furnishings and smart TV
• Private rooftop deck with skyline views
• Outdoor dining, grill, fire pit, and smart TV
• Bright, modern multi-level layout

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 12)
• This home includes 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms.
• Bedroom 1 (Primary, 3rd Floor) — King bed; smart TV; walk-in closet; ensuite bath with dual vanity and walk-in shower
• Bedroom 2 (3rd Floor) — Queen bed; smart TV; ensuite bath with shower/tub combo
• Bedroom 3 (2nd Floor) — Queen bed; smart TV; ensuite bath with shower/tub combo
• Bedroom 4 (1st Floor) — Two full beds; smart TV; dedicated workspace; ensuite bath with shower/tub combo
• Living Room — Queen sleeper sofa (sleeps 2)
• Baths — Primary ensuite with dual vanity and walk-in shower; three additional ensuite bathrooms with shower/tub combos

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with stainless appliances and basic cookware/serveware
• Breakfast bar seating
• Cookware, bakeware, dishes, utensils, and glassware provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Private washer and dryer
• High-speed WiFi
• Smart TVs throughout the home
• Dedicated workspace
• We provide bedding, towels, and a small starter set of essentials

📍 Location Highlights
• Minutes to Five Points and East Nashville dining
• Approximately 10 minutes to the Grand Ole Opry
• Approximately 11 minutes to Nissan Stadium
• Approximately 13 minutes to Broadway, the Johnny Cash Museum, and Downtown Nashville
• Approximately 14 minutes to Bridgestone Arena
• Close to The Gulch, Music Row, Geodis Park, Belmont University, and Nashville Zoo

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Trash is kept outside the garage
•  This home is pet friendly. A maximum of 2 pets may be brought to this home. - Please note that there is an additional Pet Fee per pet that is not included in your final booking cost. To pay your Pet Fee, please contact the Customer Care Team after booking. 
• Parking: 2-car garage; limited guest parking on a first-come, first-served basis in the complex
• Security: Ring doorbell at front door + exterior camera overlooking garage area
• Early check-in and late checkout are based on availability and require approval, and may be subject to an additional fee.
• Cookware, bakeware, utensils, are available for guest use.
